question: Identify the names of superheroes who possess more than 15 superpowers, have a height greater than 80% of the average superhero height, and are aligned as 'Bad'.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN alignment AS T4 ON T1."XCL_027" = T4."XCL_001"
WHERE T4."XCL_002" = 'Bad'
  AND T1."XCL_028" > 0.8 * (SELECT AVG("XCL_028") FROM superhero)
  AND T1."XCL_018" IN (
    SELECT T2."XCL_012"
    FROM hero_power AS T2
    GROUP BY T2."XCL_012"
    HAVING COUNT(T2."XCL_013") > 15
  )
